messages:
maya: heads-up — SCIM POSTs to our IdP webhook are returning 403 for new user provisioning since ~09:12 UTC. Started right after the KMS key rotation that ran at 02:40.

lucas: saw a spike in 403s too, looks like the webhook signature check failing. sample log: `webhook.verify sig=invalid alg=HS256 service=scim-provisioner`

oli: quick q — did the key alias change propagate to the edge caches? if the webhook verifies with the old mac key it will fail.

maya: I already checked KMS console — new alias + versions look fine. But audit logs show the provisioning service used `service-account-scim` and an encrypt context `env=prod tenant=redwood`.

security-bot: [audit] KMS RotateKey invoked by user=ops@redwood.com key=projects/keys/scim-provisioner at=2024-06-12T02:40:12Z

lucas: can someone curl the webhook with the signing header we compute locally?

oli: trying now — pasted command: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://idp.internal/scim/v2/Users -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-SCIM-Signature: sha256=..." -d '{"userName":"test.user","active":true}'
```

oli: result: 403 with body `{"error":"signature mismatch","code":403}` — our computed sig matches the one stored in local secret store (vault).

maya: vault shows secret `scim/webhook/hmac` pointing to ksv:alias/old-key-version. I think the provisioning service updated to new KMS key, but vault didn't re-encrypt the HMAC secret; the service is sending sigs signed by new key while IdP expects old sig (or vice-versa).

lucas: that would explain intermittent failures if some instances still have cached old secret. Can we force a reload of the secret and rotate the HMAC value?

oli: plan: 1) temporarily disable strict signature check on the IdP webhook (canary off) 2) rotate the HMAC secret in Vault using the new KMS alias and push to provisioner instances 3) re-enable strict check and monitor.

maya: +1 but we need audit trail for the disable step. I'll open an internal change with a note and attach the PR — want all changes logged.

lucas: I'm going to scale down provisioning replicas to 0 and back up after secret update to flush local caches. doing that now.

deploy-bot: rollback_lock: false — scale operation started for service=scim-provisioner replicas=3 -> 0 by lucas at=2024-06-12T09:25:40Z

oli: rotated the HMAC secret in Vault and re-encrypted with new KMS alias. New secret path: `scim/webhook/hmac:v2` (internal note). Pushed env var refresh to instances.

lucas: scaled back up to 3, post-rollout health checks passing. running quick smoke with `test.user2`.

lucas: smoke result: 201 created, IdP returned 200 for verify. No 403s in last 10m.

maya: confirmed in audit logs: scim.create events now show `signer=service-account-scim key_alias=alias/scim-rotated-v2`. Good.

oli: follow-ups: 1) add a post-rotate job to re-encrypt dependent secrets in Vault automatically 2) add an alert when webhook sig verification fails > 5/min 3) document the manual steps for emergency rollback.

maya: also raising a small vuln triage: the provisioning service accepted a disabled signature-policy flip; we should add RBAC guard so only ops group can toggle signature enforcement. filing a ticket.

security-bot: [note] incident mitigated. root_cause: KMS key rotation + stale secret re-encryption. mitigation: rotated HMAC secret, refreshed instances, added follow-up tickets.

lucas: marking thread resolved unless anyone sees continued 403s. :thumbsup:

oli: leaving a postmortem checklist item — include exact KMS alias migration steps and a Vault rewrap script snippet.

maya: thanks all. closing thread in 1h if green.
